scripts.compile: node scripts/compile-contract.mjs && node scripts/patch-runtime.cjs && npm run copy:managed
scripts.copy:managed: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('frontend/src/managed/contract', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.rmSync('frontend/public/managed', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('contracts/managed/echo-gate/contract', 'frontend/src/managed/contract', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('contracts/managed/echo-gate', 'frontend/public/managed', {recursive:true})"
scripts.build: npm run build -w echora-frontend && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
